summary: Iteration 18 — Lead CRM crash fix, PDF order email, AI Compare feature. Backend 11/11 pytest pass (poisoned lead sanitize on both GET /api/leads/ list and GET /api/leads/LEAD-POISON-TEST-001 detail — notes coerced to '' with 'Automated follow-up sent' folded into interactions[] as a STRING; full Lead CRUD + stage moves (contacted→won) via API; DELETE 200 on real id + 404 on non-existent; order_pdf_generator.build_order_pdf returns real PDF bytes starting with %PDF; crm_lead_notifier.notify_new_lead with extra.order_doc emitted '📎 Attached: Order-TEST-ITER18-ORD-001.pdf' and SendGrid returned 202 to dasarahalli.adityaretail@gmail.com; POST /api/products-compare/ on cached pair a828c353...+6b280e40... returned 12-row comparison JSON with summary+verdict+best_for_product1/2, second identical POST correctly returned cached:true, invalid product ids returned 404). Frontend Playwright: /admin/leads loads with poisoned lead present; drawer for 'Poison Test' opens and Activity Log renders 'Follow_up - AI CRM Agent — Automated follow-up sent' with NO error boundary; created a lead via API, opened its drawer, moved through Contacted → Won (both persisted per subsequent GET), then clicked data-testid=lead-delete-btn — verified 404 after delete; product /product/a828c353-a2a0-46b7-ac23-eede28ea13c6 → compare-product-btn opens product-compare-modal, compare-search-input present, compare-candidate-6b280e40 (cached pair) clickable, compare-result renders full comparison table with green advantage highlights and Expert Verdict; regression: Sales/Service/Delivery/Expert Consultation tabs all render clean; Customer CRM 'View Details' still opens customer-detail-modal. Only issue noted is minor UX: 'Total Leads' funnel counter shows the LAST-VIEWED tab's count instead of 'All Leads' count when a tab is active — cosmetic only.

issues: When a team tab (e.g. 'Expert Consultation') is active, the top-left stat card is labeled 'Expert Consultation Leads: 1' but the 'All Leads' tab shows 13. When 'All Leads' is active the card reverts to 'Total Leads: 0' (probably because it reflects the currently-filtered subset AFTER search). Cosmetic only — data accessible via team tabs.

critical_code_review_comments: leads_management_routes.py sanitize_lead() correctly folds list-notes into interactions and stringifies non-primitive values inside interactions/follow_ups — good defensive design. sanitize is applied on both list endpoint and single-lead endpoint, which prevents front-end crash symmetrically.

leads_management_routes.py update_lead() when only 'notes' is passed inserts an interaction but does NOT call the $set with update_fields — that's fine because update_fields only carries updated_at. Just document that a pure notes update won't refresh updated_at (minor).
product_compare_routes.py caches on pair_key using sorted product ids — so order-swapped inputs hit the same cache row. Correct. LLM cost saved.
crm_lead_notifier.py catches PDF generation exceptions and still sends the email without attachment — resilient. Consider logging PDF size when successful for observability.

order_pdf_generator.py uses a ternary in TableStyle at line 75 (`('SPAN', (1,-1),(3,-1)) if addr_line else ('BOTTOMPADDING',...)`) which duplicates the BOTTOMPADDING command; not a bug (it just repeats the pad) but is confusing — consider building the style list conditionally.
